testcase.name: Scenario: Collapse and expands descendants of the solid bodies folder: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:217:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse and expands descendants of the solid bodies folder ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And an active part in the MCAD Software has one solid body made by an extrusion from a sketch ✔ And the Solid Bodies folder shows the body, its extrusion and nested sketch ✔ When the user right-clicks Solid Bodies and chooses Collapse All Children ✔ Then the body row remains visible under the folder ✔ And the extrusion and sketch rows under the body are hidden ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport ✔ When the user right-clicks Solid Bodies and chooses Expand All Children ✔ Then the body's extrusion and nested sketch rows are visible again ✔ And the solid remains visible in the same apparent view
